requirement_text.REQ-003: Add 'en' to src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array (now ["ru","uz","en"]), defaultLocale stays "ru". Create messages/en.json matching messages/ru.json's 177-leaf-key structure, every value duplicated verbatim from ru.json as a placeholder except Metadata.ogLocale = "en_US".
